title: Campaign Definition
description: Schema for a BAR campaign definition file in data/singleplayer/campaigns/<campaign>/campaign.json. The subfolders named in its 'missions' list are its missions.

identifier.description: A non-empty string containing only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

i18nKey.description: A dotted I18N key, never literal text. Resolved against language/<lang>.json.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this file.

titleKey.description: I18N key for the display title of the campaign.

descriptionKey.description: I18N key for the short description shown in the campaign selection UI.

backgroundImage.description: Filename of the background image used on the campaign screen, relative to this campaign's folder.

logo.description: Filename of the campaign / faction logo image, relative to this campaign's folder.

prerequisites.description: List of campaign IDs that must be completed before this one is unlocked.

missions.description: Folders to load missions from, in display order. 'shared' and 'language' are reserved names and cannot be used.
